During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''individual''' served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Unidentified Imperial garrison (Coveway)|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coveway]]. The commander eventually decided that the parameters of the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison's]] [[Mission to Coveway|mission]] on Coveway called for the elimination of the native residents of the local area. Subsequently, the commander ordered the destruction of a small [[Unidentified village (Coveway)|village]].<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
